decisions.title: ABQ RIDE Sun Van Compliance Review Briefing
decisions.description: Summarizes a 2010 consultant review of Sun Van’s ADA paratransit service, documenting eligibility, service area, reservations, fares, trip times, capacity constraints, driver practices, and recommended eligibility-process improvements while finding no ADA compliance violations.
processing_notes: Original authoritative 16-slide PowerPoint preserved without modification.
All slides were rendered and visually reviewed before inclusion.
The source collection and exact official file URL are retained for provenance and update checking.

decisions.title: Draft Sun Van Performance Metrics
decisions.description: Defines draft Sun Van performance measures covering ridership, cost, productivity, cancellations, no-shows, subsidy, on-time pickups, missed trips, scheduling flexibility, and complaint categories, preserving how the City proposed to monitor paratransit service in 2010.
processing_notes: Original authoritative two-page PDF preserved without modification.
Extracted text and document metadata identify the document as a May 2010 draft despite the legacy source filename.
The source collection and exact official file URL are retained for provenance and update checking.
